lead.headline: Lamar’s back, and Santa Clara’s Finest has a pulse
lead.dek: Yesterday Jackson was Out and Santa Clara’s Finest was about a one-in-five shot. This morning the tag is gone, he’s projected for 20.49, and Big Stric Energy’s 72.62-point Thursday cushion is suddenly a 60.8% proposition.
lead.pull: 72.62 to nothing, and it’s only 60.8% to 39.2%.
body: Yesterday I wrote this team’s obituary. Lamar Jackson was listed Out, Santa Clara’s Finest starts two quarterbacks, and the bench didn’t have a healthy one. A 1-6 team down 72.62 to nothing with half a quarterback room is not a matchup. It’s a formality.

Then the Out tag came off. Jackson is no longer on the injury report, he’s still in the QB slot, and he’s projected for 20.49 next to Joe Burrow’s 21.97. Story resolved, and the call made itself: Santa Clara’s Finest didn’t have to touch a thing. At full strength the projection is 159.57 to 148.08, and the win probability is 60.8% Big Stric Energy, 39.2% Santa Clara’s Finest. Yesterday it was barely a one-in-five shot. Nobody in this franchise’s front office will complain about that math.

The hill is still steep. Big Stric Energy banked 72.62 on Thursday night: Josh Jacobs 23.2, Jordan Love 22.52, Tucker Kraft 17.3, Jalen Coker 9.6. It still has Josh Allen (24.48 projected), Justin Jefferson (17.63) and Ashton Jeanty (15.97) to come. Santa Clara’s Finest has all eleven starters left, led by Kenneth Walker III at 20.65 and Garrett Wilson at 16.96.

Here’s why you watch anyway: Big Stric Energy is 1-6 and has blown a 43.82-point lead in the last two weeks. This franchise knows exactly how fast a Thursday lead can turn into a Monday problem. The other franchise in this game is also 1-6. The loser of this one is staring at the basement, with playoff odds of 17.3% for Big Stric Energy and 10.2% for Santa Clara’s Finest.
My call: Big Stric Energy holds on, but I wouldn’t bet the house. Watch the early games. If Walker and Wilson hit, this gets loud by the afternoon.

quick_hits.headline: The first-place projection flipped overnight
quick_hits.body: Yesterday Poochinski was the slimmest of favorites. This morning Bad things man bad things is 50.8%, with 68.96 already banked and a full-strength projection of 170.77 to 169.91. Poochinski’s set lineup projects for 159.16, and the gap is one open WR slot.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom went to work Saturday night
quick_hits.body: Trevor Lawrence (20.4) is in at QB for Bo Nix. Jaylen Warren (14.42) took Christian McCaffrey’s RB spot. And at 9:36 PM Saturday the front office added Jonah Coleman (11.54) and dropped kicker Cameron Dicker, then put Coleman straight into the lineup. One call left: the flex.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom vs. deeboliciouskins is 48.9 to 51.1
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins filled its Malik Nabers hole with Tyler Warren (11.11). At full strength it projects 155.77 to Cherry Blossom’s 154.63. Neither team has scored a point yet, and this is the game where the 10:00 a.m. lineup calls matter most.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 still has two holes and one bench answer
quick_hits.body: DeVonta Smith is Out and Mike Evans is off this week. Mark Andrews covers one spot, and the other needs the waiver wire. The set lineup projects for 132.07, the best version for 140.85, and AB81 is a 32.6% underdog to the champ.

quick_hits.headline: Maye I touch your TDs? gets its receivers back
quick_hits.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown and Drake London are off the injury report and in the lineup. Christian Watson already put up 17.3 on Thursday. The champ projects for 159.86 and is a 67.4% favorite.

w8-m1.headline: Lamar returns to a 72.62-point hole
w8-m1.blurb: Big Stric Energy leads 72.62 to nothing and projects for 159.57 to 148.08. With Jackson cleared, Santa Clara’s Finest is up to 39.2%.

w8-m2.headline: First place, 0.86 apart
w8-m2.blurb: Bad things man bad things has 68.96 banked and projects for 170.77. Poochinski projects for 169.91 at full strength with every starter still to play. 50.8% to 49.2%.

w8-m3.headline: Two bye-week patch jobs, one playoff seed
w8-m3.blurb: deeboliciouskins projects for 155.77, Cherry Blossom for 154.63. Both teams have patched their holes. Whoever wins the flex and WR calls wins the game.

w8-m4.headline: The champ, at full strength, against a short roster
w8-m4.blurb: Maye I touch your TDs? leads 17.3 to nothing and projects for 159.86. AB81 projects for 140.85 at best and needs a waiver add to get there.

trending_notes.13294: Available in R.A.T.S. and projected for 9.52. AB81 has an open spot.
trending_notes.4147: Available and projected for 9.13. A real Sunday plug-in.
trending_notes.11783: Available and projected for 9.09. Poochinski needs a receiver, if it wants one.

2026-11-01-m1.blurb: Cherry Blossom added Jonah Coleman (11.54 projected) at 9:36 PM Saturday, dropped a spare kicker in Cameron Dicker, and started Coleman right away. Late, smart and in a coin-flip game.

w8-r7-s0.headline: Resolved: Lamar Jackson stays in at QB
w8-r7-s0.blurb: Yesterday he was Out and Santa Clara’s Finest had no healthy QB on the bench. This morning the tag is gone and he’s projected for 20.49. The best kind of lineup decision: the one that solves itself.

w8-r4-s1.headline: Resolved: Cherry Blossom goes with Lawrence
w8-r4-s1.blurb: Trevor Lawrence (20.4) is in, Bo Nix is on the bench. The right call in a game projected at 48.9% to 51.1%.

w8-r2-s5.headline: Still open: what will Poochinski do at WR?
w8-r2-s5.blurb: Chris Olave is off this week and the bench has no receiver. The likely play is sliding a flex receiver over and putting Quinshon Judkins (10.75) in the flex. That’s the difference between a 159.16 set lineup and a 169.91 ceiling, in a game for first place. Clock runs out at 10:00 a.m.

w8-r4-s8.headline: Cherry Blossom’s last call: the flex
w8-r4-s8.blurb: Jameson Williams (9.75) is starting. Parker Washington (15.51) and Tre Tucker (11.2) are on the bench. I’d start Washington. In a game this close, that’s not a small gap.

w8-r6-s4.headline: Pickens or Moore? Pick a shoulder
w8-r6-s4.blurb: George Pickens (14.53) and DJ Moore (14.0) are both Questionable with shoulder injuries. deeboliciouskins has Pickens in. Whoever is active by 10:00 a.m. is the answer.

w8-r3-s2.headline: Breece Hall is Questionable. The champ has options
w8-r3-s2.blurb: Hall (11.31) is starting with a quad issue. Omarion Hampton (10.16) and Aaron Jones Sr. (9.82) are the fallbacks. A small gap, so this one is all about the inactive list.

w8-r8-s8.headline: AB81 needs a body for Mike Evans’ slot
w8-r8-s8.blurb: The bench has nothing for this spot. Makai Lemon (9.52) is still on the wire. For a front office that does not make moves, this is the week to make one.
